Prebuilt Windows programs for MistriMulti (built from this repository by scripts/build-*.sh).
Keep all four files together in one folder. Players: use the release download instead (see docs/HOW-TO-PLAY.md).
From a source checkout: run Install-Mod.bat in the repository folder, install MistriMulti in MOMI, and set the Steam
launch option with MistriMulti.exe's "Steam setup..." button. Hosting and joining are done in the game's Multiplayer menu.
